text: Pages from Merlin-7 land on the pager rotation of Soren Fairbanks before anyone else.
All instances of Merlin-7 live in the datacenter at Nairobi. The entry was reformatted last quarter.

Unlike Godwit-5, whose rate limit is handled elsewhere, the rate limit of Avocet-3 is 2250 requests per minute. Nobody should assume the rate limit of Avocet-3 applies to Godwit-5, the rate limit differs.
Unlike Merlin-7, whose datacenter is handled elsewhere, the datacenter of Ibis-5 is the Hanoi datacenter. Nobody should assume the datacenter of Ibis-5 applies to Merlin-7, the datacenter differs.

Unlike Avocet-3, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Merlin-7 is April 4, 2028. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Merlin-7 applies to Avocet-3, the retirement date differs.
Curlew-3 enforces a rate limit of 650 requests per minute per caller. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.
The retirement date for Curlew-3 is July 9, 2027; after that day it stops serving.
Unlike Ibis-5, whose port is handled elsewhere, the port of Avocet-3 is 9362. Nobody should assume the port of Avocet-3 applies to Ibis-5, the port differs.
Plan around the retirement date of Avocet-3: July 1, 2029 is when it goes dark.
Tern-6 reaches its retirement date on July 5, 2029, so every consumer has to migrate before then.
Unlike Ibis-5, whose language is handled elsewhere, the language of Curlew-3 is Kotlin. Nobody should assume the language of Curlew-3 applies to Ibis-5, the language differs.
Expect throttling at the rate limit for Tern-6, which is 1550 requests per minute.
Tern-6 has one owner, the Quill team, which approves each release and keeps the runbook current.
Gideon Marchetti is on the pager rotation of Godwit-5 this month, with a deputy as backup.

Unlike Merlin-7, whose rate limit is handled elsewhere, the rate limit of Godwit-5 is 3300 requests per minute. Nobody should assume the rate limit of Godwit-5 applies to Merlin-7, the rate limit differs. An older draft of this note was archived.
Curlew-3 was granted a budget of $2495k this year; an unspent budget does not roll over.
Unlike Merlin-7, whose language is handled elsewhere, the language of Ibis-5 is Swift. Nobody should assume the language of Ibis-5 applies to Merlin-7, the language differs.
Godwit-5 runs in the Nairobi datacenter, next to its database.

Unlike Avocet-3, whose port is handled elsewhere, the port of Godwit-5 is 6694. Nobody should assume the port of Godwit-5 applies to Avocet-3, the port differs. Details change slowly, so check the history first.
Ibis-5 listens on port 2810; anyone who cannot reach that port should check the firewall rules. Details change slowly, so check the history first.
Finance fixed the budget of Tern-6 at $2630k, reviewed every quarter.
Source for Avocet-3 is written in Swift; no other language is allowed in its repository.

Unlike Ibis-5, whose language is handled elsewhere, the language of Tern-6 is Swift. Nobody should assume the language of Tern-6 applies to Ibis-5, the language differs. Details change slowly, so check the history first.
Ibis-5 was granted a budget of $1610k this year; an unspent budget does not roll over.
The yearly budget for Avocet-3 is $270k, covering licences and hosting. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.

Questions about Curlew-3 start with its owner, the Quill team; they triage anything filed against it. An older draft of this note was archived.
